issues.quote: That was in Chapter 1, before anything hardened.

issues.what: Birgit's forty-year print reveal repeated as if new (ch2, again in ch3, full re-staging in ch4, again in ch6), with the brief line repeated word for word each time
issues.quote: The sun has never touched the steps from that angle

issues.what: Birgit says she and Torunn shot the steps together on the 16th, but on the 16th Torunn was on the fjord ice with the bears; ch6 then dates the bears to the 14th
issues.quote: The sixteenth. You remember. We stood there. You with your machine.

issues.what: Torunn says Ragnhild pointed south 'four days ago', but in ch3 (13 Mar) Ragnhild already said it has always risen there; 'always risen there' planned moment replayed as new; Ragnhild is said to have read 'sixteen' when she read 5.2
issues.quote: Four days ago you said the notch was south.

issues.what: Sun-angle arithmetic broken: az 176.5 vs expected 172.4 is further south, not north; ch2 gives az 176.4 as +1.2 on ch1's 177.6; ch3 calls a 2.7 deg jump 'a fraction'
issues.quote: Az 176.5 deg. Alt 0.3 deg. Expected az 172.4. Error plus 4.1 N.

issues.what: Bear scene compass contradicts itself: sun on her left and behind her, bears NE 'away from the sun' which stands NE, and on the ride back the sun is on her left 'where it should not be' (which is normal going west)
issues.quote: keeping the sun on her left where it should not be

issues.what: Duplicate titles: ch2, ch3 and ch6 all 'The Hospital Steps'; ch1 and ch4 both 'The Old Hospital Steps'
Year drift: ch2 logs this year as 2025, ch4 as 2026 (40 years from 1986 is 2026)
issues.quote: sun on peak 1986 to 2024, sun left of peak 2025

issues.what: Real brands: Wild T2 theodolite, Praktica, Leica
issues.quote: I had a Praktica and a tripod with one leg that stuck.

issues.what: Glasses appear from nowhere on Torunn (ch2) and Ragnhild (ch5); Birgit's house becomes a flat (ch4, ch6)
issues.quote: Steam rose and fogged her glasses for a second.

issues.what: Ch6 recalls Ragnhild bending to the eyepiece on sun day and dates the logbook entry 11:36; ch1 has neither (12:14, she never looked)
Repeated openings 'Torunn woke before the alarm' (ch2, ch4, ch6); 'The words landed' repeated; 'summers of sun' when solfest is March
issues.quote: Torunn woke before the alarm. The bedroom was blue with early light.

fix: Retitle all six chapters. Ch1-3: make the logged angles consistent (4.1, 5.2, 6.4, 9.1 accelerating, 11, 14, 16, 20, 38), remove brands, fix 2025/2026. Ch3, 4, 6: turn Birgit's repeated table reveal into new beats (husband's pencil angles on the backs in ch4, the 8 Mar print now empty in ch6). Ch4: fix the bear-scene compass. Ch5: move Torunn off the steps on the 16th and fix Ragnhild's recall. Ch6: remove 'Chapter 1' meta text, fix the sun-day recall and the bears date.
praise: Cold, exact logbook dread that gets steadily worse: the looped six, the empty prints and the ending where Torunn draws the curtains are all earned.

issues.what: Brief text pasted into dialogue and narration
issues.quote: You are kind enough to warn me... And too frightened to help much.
Everything in Vessman towers got marked down somewhere.

issues.what: Premise sentence lifted word for word into Anders's warning
issues.quote: On the last night of the Census the Ledger gives each count a name.

issues.what: Final image of 'the second hook waited empty' doesn't fit: she set both mugs upside down, so both hooks were empty
issues.quote: She washed both mugs and set them upside down.

praise: A tight, witty, genuinely eerie single night; the mirror slices and 'Three, Lord close the book' are excellent, and the ending is a real choice.
